notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): MSUI has a macro window (Program.Macro.cs): 384x512 shell with MacroFrame-BotLeft/BotRight + MacroFrame-Icon art, an 18-slot icon grid with selection ring, name and multi-line body editors, New/Delete/Run/Exit buttons, drag-from-grid to the action bar, double-click-to-run, and persistence to macros.json. Macro icons are auto-derived from the body (#cast/#use spell/item lookup) rather than picked.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Auto-deriving the icon from the macro body instead of a picker popup is a deliberate MSUI simplification of the same function - candidate for a ruling on whether the picker is required.
